summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new features for Agence Prela. Backend API (POST /api/devis) works correctly. Frontend features mostly working but has a critical Unicode encoding bug affecting French accented characters.

ui_bugs.issue: Unicode encoding bug - French accented characters display as escape sequences (e.g., \u00e9 instead of é)
affected_areas: Sky banner text: 'VOS PROJETS M\U00E9RITENT' instead of 'VOS PROJETS MÉRITENT'
Success message: 'Demande envoy\u00e9e' instead of 'Demande envoyée'
ui_bugs.root_cause: Source code in App.js contains Unicode escape sequences instead of actual UTF-8 characters

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/devis endpoint accepts form data and returns success (8/8 tests passed)
Backend: All project types accepted (Construction neuve, Rénovation, Extension, etc.)
Backend: GET /api/devis returns list of devis requests
Frontend: All 5 navigation links visible and functional (À propos, Services, Portfolio, FAQ, Contact)
Frontend: All 4 service cards displayed (Jalon, Consultation, Aplomb, Mission)
Frontend: Aplomb card has 'Voir tous les détails' toggle that expands to show detailed analysis list
Frontend: Aplomb expanded details show analysis items (Formalité exacte, Surface de plancher, etc.)
Frontend: Portfolio section displays 9 images with shadow-md class (drop shadows)
Frontend: Sky banner positioned between Contact section and Footer
Frontend: Sky banner text is white, uppercase, with wide letter-spacing (tracking-[0.3em])
Frontend: Devis form has all 7 fields (Nom, Email, Téléphone, Type de projet, Localisation, Description, Budget)
Frontend: Devis form submission works and shows success message
Frontend: All 4 service card Stripe links are correct (Jalon→Netlify, Consultation→Stripe, Aplomb→Stripe, Mission→Stripe)
Frontend: 3 Stripe payment buttons in payment section
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Unicode encoding in App.js - Replace all \u00XX escape sequences with actual UTF-8 French characters (é, è, à, ç, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: App.js lines 488-685, 1117-1131: Unicode escape sequences used instead of UTF-8 characters - causes display issues for French text
seed_data_creation: Test devis requests created via API tests with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features work correctly except for Unicode encoding bug. The devis form, Aplomb expandable details, portfolio shadows, and sky banner positioning are all implemented correctly. Main issue is French accented characters displaying as escape sequences.
rca_of_the_issue: The Unicode encoding bug is caused by the source code containing JavaScript Unicode escape sequences (\u00e9, \u00e8, etc.) instead of actual UTF-8 characters. This likely happened during code generation or copy-paste. Fix by replacing all escape sequences with their corresponding characters: \u00e9→é, \u00e8→è, \u00e0→à, \u00c9→É, \u00e7→ç, \u00ef→ï, \u00fb→û, \u00b2→², \u00b7→·
